valores.label: depth on the bar at the entrance, at mean low tide, before 1871 (upper bound)

fonte: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (Report of the Chief of Engineers 1892)
legenda: Before 1871: less than 2 ft of water on the bar at low tide.
texto_para_tela: LESS THAN 2 FT (BEFORE 1871) · at low tide
credito_tela: (sem linha de fonte na cena; a voz diz 'by the Army's own measure')
nota: As fontes do Exército dão números diferentes para a barra antes das obras (T04): cerca de 1 pé (Benyaurd, 1888), cerca de 2 (junta Craighill, 1892), menos de 2 (Chief of Engineers 1892 e 1898). Os 18 polegadas são de Meyler (1891) e Willard e ficaram fora (T04).
narracao: The only shelter was the estuary at Wilmington, a tidal inlet behind Rattlesnake Island, which is Terminal Island today. Before 1871, by the Army's own measure, the sandbar at the mouth of the estuary had less than two feet of water at low tide.
needs_dados: a barra antes de 1871: 'less than 2 feet' na maré baixa (mec.num-02, Chief of Engineers 1898) → LESS THAN 2 FT (before 1871); 18 polegadas nunca (T04)
conferencia_status: CONFERE · 1 divergência(s) listada(s), nenhuma muda a tela ou a voz

conferencia.prova: 'Before the commencement of this improvement in 1871 there was a depth of less than 2 feet at the entrance to the harbor at mean low tide.'
conferencia.tela: LESS THAN 2 FT (BEFORE 1871) · at low tide
conferencia.voz: had less than two feet of water at low tide

divergencias_com_a_tela_ou_a_voz.a_fonte_diz: o próprio Exército dá também 'about 1 foot' (1888) e 'about 2 feet' (1892)
divergencias_com_a_tela_ou_a_voz.por_que: Divergência entre as fontes, não entre a tela e a fonte citada; o dossiê escolheu o 'less than 2 feet' do Chief of Engineers (T04).
